data.body: Sequencing (operator, 2026-08-15): land the R3 gate AFTER the parallel session's remediations land — cubiform-wooden-fruitbat (bridge-state writes) and gnatty-comparable-ynambu (binding-store snapshot + alert_store) — recorded as blocked_by links. Rationale: landing R3 first would require reasoned markers on exactly the sites those tickets are deleting (merge-conflict churn in reconcile_helpers.py and friends); landing after means R3's first run should enumerate ZERO out-of-transaction sites (or only ones with a durable reason), making the gate land clean with no debt baseline. Do not claim until both blockers close.
